summary: Well-structured TypeScript + YAML with explicit types, proper error handling, and sensible module boundaries. Workflow uses pinned actions (checkout@v4, setup-bun@v2), least-privilege permissions, and reasonable job separation. Minor issues: (1) workflow hardcodes fixture paths (fixtures/scenario-python/) not shown in provided sources—unclear if fixtures exist; (2) bash conditional in license-check job lacks explanatory comment; (3) loop increment pattern in parseArgs (src/cli.ts:24–31) is functionally correct but non-obvious; (4) no validation that fixtures exist before execution. For a production workflow, verify all referenced fixture paths exist and consider adding set -euo pipefail to shell steps explicitly.
